newsitem.title: USA: US spot natgas supported by cold,decline in stocks.
newsitem.headline: US spot natgas supported by cold,decline in stocks.

text.p: U.S. spot natgas prices were mixed Thursday, as cold weather continued in the Northeast but forecasts called for milder temperatures this weekend throughout the eastern half of the U.S., industry sources said.
Gulf Coast gas traded about two to three cents higher in the low-to-mid $2.70s, supported by cold weather in the Northeast and forecasts for more below-normal temperatures by the middle of next week.
At the Henry Hub, La., most deals were confirmed done in the $2.73-2.75 area.
